title: Xanthe and the Cover
author: Edmund Delacroix
blurb: Felix Villalobos, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
